operations.name: channel.create
operations.description: Create a new empty saved alpha channel. Saved alpha channels are the same storage used by Save/Load Selection.

operations.name: channel.delete
operations.description: Delete a saved alpha channel by id/name.

operations.name: channel.duplicate
operations.description: Duplicate a component, Quick Mask, or alpha channel into a saved alpha channel.

operations.name: channel.from_selection
operations.description: Save the current selection as a new alpha channel.

operations.name: channel.list
operations.description: List RGB component channels, saved alpha channels, and Quick Mask when active. Includes current channel preview visibility.

operations.name: channel.rename
operations.description: Rename a saved alpha channel; the Save/Load Selection name changes with it.

operations.name: channel.to_selection
operations.description: Load a channel into the pixel selection. mode defaults to replace and supports add/subtract/intersect.

channel.description: Channel id/name; defaults to active channel

mode.description: How to combine with the existing selection

operations.name: channel.view
operations.description: Set the view-only channel preview. channel is rgb/red/green/blue/quickmask or alpha:<name>; add=true shift-clicks into the visible set.

channel.description: Channel id or alpha channel name

add.description: Add/toggle this channel in the visible set instead of replacing
